name: Get Starter Pokémon
description: Visit Professor Oak's lab and choose your first Pokémon.

name: Deliver Oak's Parcel
description: Get the parcel from Viridian City Mart and bring it back to Oak.

name: Get Pokedex
description: Receive the Pokedex and Pokeballs from Professor Oak.

name: Boulder Badge
description: Defeat Brock in Pewter City Gym.

name: Cross Mt. Moon
description: Navigate through Mt. Moon to reach Cerulean City.

name: Cascade Badge
description: Defeat Misty in Cerulean City Gym.

name: Get HM01 Cut
description: Visit the Captain on the S.S. Anne in Vermilion City.

name: Thunder Badge
description: Defeat Lt. Surge in Vermilion City Gym.

name: Cross Rock Tunnel
description: Navigate through Rock Tunnel to reach Lavender Town.

name: Rainbow Badge
description: Defeat Erika in Celadon City Gym.

name: Clear Silph Co.
description: Defeat Team Rocket and Giovanni in Saffron City.

name: Soul Badge
description: Defeat Koga in Fuchsia City Gym.

name: Marsh Badge
description: Defeat Sabrina in Saffron City Gym.

name: Volcano Badge
description: Defeat Blaine in Cinnabar Island Gym.

name: Earth Badge
description: Defeat Giovanni in Viridian City Gym.

name: Victory Road
description: Navigate Victory Road to reach the Indigo Plateau.

name: Elite Four
description: Defeat the Elite Four and the Champion.
